title: A groupoid approach to the equivariant coarse Baum--Connes conjecture
summary: In this paper, we develop a groupoid approach to the equivariant coarse Baum--Connes conjecture. For a bounded geometry metric space $X$ equipped with a proper, free, and isometric action of a countable discrete group $Γ$, we introduce the equivariant coarse groupoid $G(X, Γ)$. We prove that the groupoid Baum--Connes conjecture for $G(X, Γ)$ with coefficients in $\ell^{\infty}(X,\mathcal{K})^Γ$ is equivalent to the equivariant coarse Baum--Connes conjecture for $(X, Γ)$ using a localization algebra description of equivariant $KK^\mathcal{G}$-theory for étale groupoids.
